title: Learning Gaussian Process Priors with Linear Semigroups and Kinetic Regularisation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29796v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce a semigroup-based construction of Gaussian process (GP) priors. A linear semigroup transforms a source GP at $t=0$ into a prior at $t=1$, enabling computationally tractable regression. Linearity preserves Gaussianity, allowing us to characterise the evolution of the covariance and draw connections with optimal transport and convolution models. The semigroup is parametrised by its generator, which is learned through two competing objectives: the marginal likelihood encourages agreement with observations, while a kinetic-energy regulariser favours lower-energy trajectories and limits unnecessary mass displacement from the source GP. Experiments on independent GP draws show that, with sufficiently many training functions, the learned prior provides accurate predictions on held-out functions, while kinetic regularisation substantially reduces the energy of the generated trajectories without compromising prediction accuracy.

translated_title: 基于线性半群与动能正则化的高斯过程先验学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种基于半群的高斯过程（GP）先验构造方法。一个线性半群将 $t=0$ 时刻的源高斯过程变换为 $t=1$ 时刻的先验，从而实现计算上可处理的回归。线性性保持了高斯性，使我们能够刻画协方差的演化，并与最优传输和卷积模型建立联系。该半群由其生成元参数化，生成元通过两个相互竞争的目标进行学习：边际似然鼓励与观测数据保持一致，而动能正则化项则偏好较低能量的轨迹，并限制从源高斯过程出发的不必要的质量位移。在独立高斯过程样本上的实验表明，当训练函数数量足够多时，学习到的先验能够对留出函数给出准确的预测，同时动能正则化在不损害预测精度的前提下显著降低了生成轨迹的能量。
tldr: 该论文提出一种通过线性半群变换构造高斯过程先验的新方法，通过在边际似然与动能正则化两个竞争目标之间学习半群生成元，在保持高斯性和计算可行性的同时提升回归预测精度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel semigroup-based construction of Gaussian process priors, learning the semigroup generator through competing objectives of marginal likelihood and kinetic-energy regularisation, enabling computationally tractable regression while preserving Gaussianity and prediction accuracy.
